focus.name: scene-resource-service-marker-static
focus.purpose: Name the shared scene/resource service marker at 0x00FFF158 without promoting it to a reader-backed gate.

contracts: Frame_InputAndResourceService sets byte 0x00FFF158 before its VDP/palette service body and clears it on completion.
Interaction_UpdateResourceState sets byte 0x00FFF158 around its mode-0x1B and mode-0x1C resource handoffs and clears it before returning.
No current whole-ROM reader or stronger gate semantics is claimed.
conclusion: 0x00FFF158 has a stable shared scene/resource service-marker identity while its reader and precise external purpose remain explicitly open.
